question: _______ Central Administrative Tribunal benches exist all over India, as of December 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is **19.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As of December 2022, **19 Central Administrative Tribunal **benches exist.
 
• Information about Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT):
 
 
• Purpose: The Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT) was established to provide an independent forum for government employees and officers to address their service matters and grievances related to recruitment, conditions of service, promotions, and disciplinary actions.
 
• Jurisdiction: CAT has jurisdiction over disputes and complaints related to central government employees, including defense personnel and members of civil services like the IAS, IPS, and IFS.
 
• Constitutional Basis: Articles 323A and 323B of the Constitution of India empower the Parliament to establish administrative tribunals for the adjudication of service matters.
 
• Administrative Structure: The CAT is headed by a Chairman and has Vice-Chairmen and Members.
 
 
• The Chairman and Vice-Chairmen are retired judges of the Supreme Court or High Courts, and Members are typically serving or retired officers from the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Police Service (IPS), or other central services.
